title: Opinion: Opinion | Sonia Gandhi Belongs Here, And She Wants Us To Know That
summary_full: Sonia Gandhi was easily the most misunderstood person in Indian politics. I believe Belonging is her way of telling us who she really was and is, writes Sanjay Jha.
